title: Rust FragmentSender ignores advertised receiver capacity
description: rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs validates receiver_limit range but never rejects payload.len() greater than that limit; PacketTooLarge is unused. FragmentSender::new therefore starts transfers known to exceed receiver capacity, contrary to the fragmentation spec. Enforce capacity before allocating/session activation and add boundary/shared-vector tests for equal, one-byte-over, large payload, and no state consumption on rejection.
